entities.summary: Jacob Eiler Bang was a Danish glass designer and architect. Bang originally studied architecture but soon changed to glass design. He joined Holmegaard Glass Factory in 1928 at a time when the company was in serious financial trouble. His functionalist glass designs received significant acclaim at international exhibitions.
